title: BU Ultrafast is live
summary: Our fastest browser agent is now on every Browser Use Cloud plan in the US, free plan included. The median task takes 22 seconds.
body_markdown:
BU Ultrafast is our fastest browser agent. Until Oct 30 it was behind a waitlist. Now it is on every Browser Use Cloud plan in the US, free plan included.


## 22 seconds, under a cent


The median task takes 22 seconds and costs $0.0064. Our default agent on GPT-6 Luna takes 79 seconds and $0.0098. That is more than 3x faster, and cheaper per task.


Source: medians of completed runs, Oct 16-29, 2026, at most 1,000 per project. Ultrafast: 12,238 runs, 134 projects. Default: 146,120 runs, 9,473 projects. In the 8 projects with 20+ runs on both, Ultrafast was faster and cheaper in all 8. Cost is the model and search charge per run; browser and proxy are billed separately.


## Try it


Set` model` to` bu-ultrafast` . Nothing else changes.


```text
curl   https://api.browser-use.com/api/v4/runs   \
-H   "X-Browser-Use-API-Key:   $BROWSER_USE_API_KEY  "   \
-H   "Content-Type: application/json"   \
-d   '{"task": "Find the cheapest flight from SFO to JFK next Friday", "model": "bu-ultrafast"}'
```


Need more reasoning per step? Use` bu-fast` . It is the same agent.


## Pricing


` bu-ultrafast` runs GPT-6 Luna on OpenAI's priority tier, so tokens bill at priority rates, 2x standard.` bu-fast` bills at standard rates, and so does` bu-ultrafast` on HIPAA projects. Both work on the free plan.


If you joined the waitlist, there is nothing to do. You already have it.


Read more:[BU Ultrafast](https://browser-use.com/ultrafast) , the[docs](https://docs.browser-use.com/cloud/agent/ultrafast) , or start in[Browser Use Cloud](https://cloud.browser-use.com/) .
